description: This file defines the OrderReadHelper class, a utility for extracting detailed information from order entities within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to access order header details, associated parties, addresses, statuses, financial totals, items, features, and related entities, facilitating various order-related computations and retrievals.

classes.name: OrderReadHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to extract and compute detailed information about an order, including header details, financial totals, items, parties, addresses, statuses, and related entities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Returns the order identifier.

methods.name: getWebSiteId
methods.description: Returns the associated website ID for the order.

methods.name: getProductStoreId
methods.description: Returns the product store ID related to the order.

methods.name: getProductStore
methods.description: Fetches the ProductStore entity associated with this order.

methods.name: getOrderTypeId
methods.description: Returns the order type identifier.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency UOM used in the order.

methods.name: getOrderName
methods.description: Returns the order name.

methods.name: getExternalId
methods.description: Returns the external ID associated with the order.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the order.

methods.name: getAdjustments
methods.description: Retrieves the list of adjustments associated with the order.

methods.name: getPaymentPreferences
methods.description: Returns the payment preferences linked to the order.

methods.name: getReceivedPaymentTotalsByPaymentMethod
methods.description: Returns a map of paymentMethodId to total amount received.

methods.name: getReturnedTotalsByPaymentMethod
methods.description: Returns a map of paymentMethodId to total amount refunded.

methods.name: getOrderPayments
methods.description: Retrieves the list of payments for the order.

methods.name: getOrderPayments
methods.description: Retrieves payments, optionally filtered by a specific preference.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of order statuses.

methods.name: getOrderTerms
methods.description: Returns the list of order terms.

methods.name: getOrderHeaderNotes
methods.description: Returns notes linked to the order, optionally filtered for internal notes.

methods.name: getOrderHeaderNotes
methods.description: Returns public notes linked to the order.

methods.name: getOrderItemAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves order item attributes, using cache or delegator.

methods.name: getOrderTermNetDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days from the first FIN_PAYMENT_TERM order term.

methods.name: getShippingMethod
methods.description: Returns the shipping method description for a specific ship group.

methods.name: getShippingMethodCode
methods.description: Returns the shipping method code for a specific ship group.

methods.name: hasShippingAddress
methods.description: Checks if the order has shipping address(es).

methods.name: hasPhysicalProductItems
methods.description: Determines if the order contains any physical product items.

methods.name: getOrderItemShipGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the order item ship group entity for a specific ship group ID.

methods.name: getOrderItemShipGroups
methods.description: Returns all order item ship groups for the order.

methods.name: getShippingLocations
methods.description: Returns a list of shipping location addresses associated with the order.

methods.name: getShippingAddress
methods.description: Returns the shipping address for a given ship group.

methods.name: getShippingAddress
methods.description: Deprecated: returns shipping address linked to the order as a whole.

methods.name: getBillingLocations
methods.description: Returns a list of billing location addresses associated with the order.

methods.name: getBillingAddress
methods.description: Deprecated: computes billing address via related entities, account, or payment methods.

methods.name: getOrderContactMechs
methods.description: Returns contact mechanisms for specified purposes (e.g., shipping, billing).

methods.name: getEarliestShipByDate
methods.description: Returns the earliest ship-by date for the order's item groups.

methods.name: getLatestShipAfterDate
methods.description: Returns the latest ship-after date for the order's item groups.

methods.name: getCurrentStatusString
methods.description: Returns the current status description for the order.

methods.name: getStatusString
methods.description: Returns the status trail description in the specified locale.

methods.name: getBillingAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the billing account linked to the order.

methods.name: getBillingAccountMaxAmount
methods.description: Gets the maximum amount authorized on the billing account.

methods.name: getBillToParty
methods.description: Returns the party entity in the role of bill-to customer.

methods.name: getBillFromParty
methods.description: Returns the party entity in the role of bill-from vendor.

methods.name: getShipToParty
methods.description: Returns the party entity in the role of ship-to customer.

methods.name: getPlacingParty
methods.description: Returns the party entity that placed the order.

methods.name: getEndUserParty
methods.description: Returns the end user party entity.

methods.name: getSupplierAgent
methods.description: Returns the supplier agent party entity.

methods.name: getPartyFromRole
methods.description: Fetches the party entity associated with a specific order role.

methods.name: getDistributorId
methods.description: Returns the distributor party identifier.

methods.name: getAffiliateId
methods.description: Returns the affiliate party identifier.

methods.name: getShippingTotal
methods.description: Calculates total order shipping adjustments.

methods.name: getHeaderTaxTotal
methods.description: Calculates total header tax adjustments.

methods.name: getTaxTotal
methods.description: Calculates total tax adjustments.

methods.name: getItemFeatureSet
methods.description: Returns set of features associated with an order item.

methods.name: getFeatureIdQtyMap
methods.description: Builds a map of product feature IDs to total quantities over order items.

methods.name: shippingApplies
methods.description: Checks if shipping applies to any valid order item.

methods.name: taxApplies
methods.description: Checks if tax applies to any valid order item.

methods.name: getShippableTotal
methods.description: Calculates total shippable amount for a ship group.

methods.name: getShippableQuantity
methods.description: Calculates total shippable quantity across all ship groups.

methods.name: getShippableQuantity
methods.description: Calculates shippable quantity for a specific ship group.

methods.name: getShippableWeight
methods.description: Computes total weight of items to be shipped in a specific group.

methods.name: getItemWeight
methods.description: Returns the shipping weight of an order item.

methods.name: getShippableSizes
methods.description: Returns list of size dimensions for shippable items.

methods.name: getOrderPaymentPreferenceTotalByType
methods.description: Total payment preference amount filtered by payment method type.

methods.name: getCreditCardPaymentPreferenceTotal
methods.description: Total preferences for credit card payment methods.

methods.name: getBillingAccountPaymentPreferenceTotal
methods.description: Total preferences for billing account payments.

methods.name: getGiftCardPaymentPreferenceTotal
methods.description: Total preferences for gift card payments.

methods.name: getOrderPaymentReceivedTotalByType
methods.description: Total amount received for payments filtered by type.

methods.name: getItemSize
methods.description: Calculates volume size of an order item.

methods.name: getItemPiecesIncluded
methods.description: Returns the number of pieces included in an order item.

methods.name: getShippableItemInfo
methods.description: Provides list of item info maps for shippable items in a group.

methods.name: getItemInfoMap
methods.description: Returns a map with details about an order item.

methods.name: getOrderEmailString
methods.description: Aggregates and returns email addresses from order contact mechanisms.

methods.name: getOrderGrandTotal
methods.description: Calculates total order amount including adjustments.

methods.name: getOrderOpenAmount
methods.description: Calculates the remaining open amount on the order.
